card.name: Start of words beginning with pan-
card.fires_on: A lone P or p (or 'op') that begins the next piece of a word, where the word likely continues as 'pan-' or 'p-a-n', as in pancytopenia, pancreatography, pantothenic. Seen mostly in medical terms and all-caps warning headers.

modes.label: Split medical terms
modes.description: A P or p that starts a longer medical word, such as pneumonitis or pancytopenia, split off from the text before it.
